transform.name: split_k
transform.description: 沿 K 维切分为 SPLIT_K 份并行计算，多 block 各自累加后 atomicAdd 归约，增加并行度、缩短单 kernel 时间。
transform.code_hint:
// grid.z = SPLIT_K; each block accumulates a K/SPLIT_K slice, then atomicAdd into C
// note: fp32 atomic accumulation changes summation order; keep within tolerance

failure_modes: K < 512 时归约开销 > 收益
atomicAdd 求和顺序不确定，可能超出容差
占用率已很高时无收益

evidence.source: CUDA C Best Practices Guide, Ch.10 Execution Configuration Optimizations

provenance: CUDA C Best Practices Guide, Ch.10 Execution Configuration Optimizations
